D3 Output Speed of Gear Trains: practice

Booklet 5 Drive Systems · Lesson D3

← Back to Lessons

What this page practises

  • I can use input speed × input size = output speed × output size.
  • I can calculate the output speed of a simple gear train.
  • I can state why two gears on one shaft turn at the same speed.
  • I can calculate the output speed of a compound gear train.
  • I can calculate the velocity ratio of a compound gear train.
D3 slides (PDF) D3 slides with answers (PDF)

Warm-up

Say it the exam way

The data booklet gives: input speed × input = output speed × output size. The size of a gear is its number of .

A small driver gear turning a large driven gear makes the output .

In a compound gear train, two gears sit on the same . They turn at the same . Work out one pair of gears at a time.

For any gear train, velocity ratio = speed of ÷ speed of output. The unit of speed is .

Check your understanding

Answer in your jotter first. Then open the answer.

1. State the data booklet relationship for the speeds and sizes of two meshing gears.

Show the answer

input speed × input size = output speed × output size

2. A 20-tooth driver gear turns at 300 revs min⁻¹. It meshes with a 60-tooth driven gear. Calculate the output speed.

Show the answer

300 × 20 = output speed × 60, so output speed = 6000 ÷ 60 = 100 revs min⁻¹

3. Two gears are fixed on the same shaft. State what is the same about them.

Show the answer

They turn at the same speed, in the same direction.

4. A gear train has a velocity ratio of 5 : 1. The input speed is 1000 revs min⁻¹. Calculate the output speed.

Show the answer

output speed = speed of input ÷ VR = 1000 ÷ 5 = 200 revs min⁻¹

5. State the type of gear train that has two gears on the same shaft.

Show the answer

A compound gear train.

6. A 10-tooth driver gear turns at 600 revs min⁻¹. It meshes with a 30-tooth gear. Calculate the output speed.

Show the answer

600 × 10 = output speed × 30, so output speed = 6000 ÷ 30 = 200 revs min⁻¹

Errors that cost marks

  • Write the unit as revs min⁻¹. "RPM" got no mark (2019, 2022, 2025).
  • Start from the data booklet relationship. Work one pair of gears at a time (2024 course report).
  • Gears on the same shaft turn at the same speed. Carry the speed across before the next pair (2019).
  • Name it in full: compound gear train (2026 course report).
  • Round the answer: 366.7 revs min⁻¹ is written 370 revs min⁻¹, to 2 significant figures (2019).

Answers

Say it the exam way

(1) size · (2) teeth · (3) slower · (4) shaft · (5) speed · (6) input · (7) revs min⁻¹

Check your understanding

  1. input speed × input size = output speed × output size
  2. 300 × 20 = output speed × 60, so output speed = 6000 ÷ 60 = 100 revs min⁻¹
  3. They turn at the same speed, in the same direction.
  4. output speed = speed of input ÷ VR = 1000 ÷ 5 = 200 revs min⁻¹
  5. A compound gear train.
  6. 600 × 10 = output speed × 30, so output speed = 6000 ÷ 30 = 200 revs min⁻¹
